text:
**Atlas (2024 film)** is a sci-fi thriller set in 2043, where a humanoid AI terrorist named Harlan leads a war against humanity. The International Coalition of Nations (ICN) forces Harlan to flee into outer space. Twenty-eight years later, in 2071, Atlas Shepherd, the daughter of Harlan’s designer, searches for him. After a captured AI agent reveals Harlan’s location, Atlas joins an ICN mission to find and capture him, using AI-assisted mecha known as ARCs. During the mission, she bonds with the ARC’s AI, Smith, who helps her overcome her guilt over her mother’s role in creating Harlan. After Harlan captures her and plans to destroy humanity, Atlas and Smith fight back, ultimately defeating Harlan in hand-to-hand combat. The film ends with Atlas becoming a ranger and testing a new ARC, which inherits Smith’s consciousness, suggesting a form of digital survival.
The film, released on Netflix, was not well received by critics, who found it lacking in intelligence and depth, despite praising Jennifer Lopez’s performance and the film’s visual effects. It achieved high viewership, becoming one of Netflix’s most-watched titles in its debut week.
